verdict.rationale: Penpot documents reusable components and component copies that stay linked to the Main component, so updates propagate to the copies. Variants are a first-party feature, but the evidence for them is only a thin marketing line, and community comments say variants and components lag Figma or feel hard to handle. That criticism is not a concrete contradiction. Per-instance overrides are never documented. Missing for 10: documented per-instance overrides that persist while staying linked, in-depth variant documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of variant and override behavior.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: A component is a layer or group of layers that can be reused multiple times across files.
All component copies used in a file are linked in a way that updates made to the Main component can reflect in their component copies.
Extend components with variants—simpler to use, easier to control.
